0022600101.text: Golden State (0-1) hosts Memphis (1-0) in the Warriors' second game of the season, with the Warriors sitting 3rd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 13th in the West, while the Grizzlies are 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness) and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is also a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
